## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "There is no template for [...]".

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen (new distro/version, new architecture, new provisioning step, ...).

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've tried.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, example configs, related issues.
